feature.problem: Groq openai/gpt-oss-* plain Responses health works, but tool-bearing SSE streaming requests fail while bounded blocking Responses tool requests work.
feature.fix: Pre-send capability selector routes only Groq openai/gpt-oss-* requests that actually contain tool definitions through the existing bounded blocking Responses transport. It is not a failed-stream retry and does not duplicate already-sent requests.
feature.non_tool_behavior: Non-tool GPT-OSS and other provider/model combinations retain normal streaming behavior unless the user independently disables streaming.
feature.api_contract: Responses API remains the common request contract.

acceptance.provider_health: PROVIDER TEST groq with openai/gpt-oss-20b returned OK in 4s, tested=1 responsive=1 failed=0.
acceptance.streaming_discriminator: Without selector/manual override, tool AGENT failed quickly with LLM request failed.
acceptance.manual_blocking_discriminator: With OVMS_AGENT_NOSTREAM=1, read-only AGENT executed read_file_range, survived bounded rate-limit retry, and returned correct answer.
acceptance.automatic_selector: With no OVMS_AGENT_NOSTREAM override on d7e62df, read-only AGENT executed read_file_range and returned correct answer.
acceptance.guarded_write: AGENT/WRITE created exactly requested M294_GPTOSS_WRITE_PROBE.TXT content; probe existed only as ;1, was verified, then deleted. Provider/model restored.
acceptance.residual_model_behavior: After successful create_file, GPT-OSS requested replace_text unnecessarily, but no second RMS write materialized.
acceptance.help_topic: OVMS_AGENT COMMANDS CORE PROVIDER_CMD displayed the M294 tool-transport compatibility note.

standing_rules: Read RULES.MD on main and this state at chat start.
GitHub is the default repository editing control plane; OpenVMS V9.2-3 x86-64 is the current canonical compile/link/RMS/runtime acceptance host.
Omit OVMS-AGENT> from agent command lines provided for paste.
Use GITAUTH for authenticated Git network operations; it already invokes Git.
Never trust Git status/porcelain/ref output or $STATUS alone on OpenVMS when RMS-visible files/control files can verify the fact directly.
Consult DOC/OPENVMS_GIT_QUIRKS.MD before inventing a new OpenVMS Git materialization workflow.
Canonical product acceptance requires All regression tests passed., Build completed successfully., and %X00000001 when source/build/runtime inputs changed.
Do not call an untested GitHub candidate or promoted merge native-green; distinguish exact-SHA native acceptance from tree-equivalent or source/HLP-equivalent promotion.
Keep root-level OVMS_AGENT.HLP synchronized with every user-visible command/persistent-setting/material behavior change in the same milestone.
Beginning with 1.0.0, semantic releases use vX.Y.Z tags in addition to mNNN milestone tags and follow semantic versioning.
Use uppercase DOC as the canonical documentation-history directory; root-level repository filenames are uppercase unless an external constraint requires otherwise.
DEC C/VAX-facing external identifiers remain <=31 characters and C89/DEC C compatible unless a subsystem specifically requires otherwise.
Keep main and chat-session-state permanently, retain only the two most recently completed milestone development branches, and never prune unique unpromoted work.
